20:38.text: "When We inspired your mother with that which We inspired.

; then the river shall cast it up on the bank, and there, an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his shall take him.’ And I endued you with love from Me, in order that you may be brought up under My Eye.

20:40.text: "When your sister went and said: ‘Shall I show you one who will nurse him?’ So We restored you to your mother, that she might cool her eyes and she should not grieve. Then you did kill a man, but We saved you from great distress and tried you with a heavy trial. Then you stayed a number of years with the people of Madyan
. Then you came here according to the fixed term which I ordained

20:42.text: "Go you and your brother with My Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
, and do not, you both, slacken and become weak in My Remembrance.

20:43.text: (all bounds in disbelief and disobedience and behaved as an arrogant and as a tyrant)

20:44.text: "And speak to him mildly, perhaps he may accept admonition or fear

20:45.text: They said: "Our Lord! Verily we fear lest he should hasten to punish us or lest he should transgress

20:46.text: said: "Fear not, verily I am with you both, hearing and seeing.

20:47.text: "So go you both to him, and say: ‘Verily, we are Messengers of your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us, and torment them not; indeed, we have come with a sign from your Lord! And peace will be upon him who follows the guidance!

20:48.text: "Truly, it has been revealed to us that the torment will be for him who denies
[believes not in the Oneness of Allâh, and in His Messengers.]
(from the truth and obedience of Allâh)

20:49.text: , is the Lord of you two?"

20:50.text: said: "Our Lord is He Who gave to each thing its form and nature, then guided it aright."

20:51.text: said: "What about the generations of old?"
